source_title: Dragon Ball: 5 Strongest Versions of Raditz in the Multiverse, Ranked
source_excerpt:
Renan is the Anime Lead Editor for GameRant. Ren graduated Cum Laude from Lesley University in 2017 and has been focusing exclusively on his journalistic endeavors ever since. When Ren isn't working, he's usually playing video games or reading.
Raditz is treated as something of a joke in the Dragon Ball franchise, but he doesn't deserve such a Yamcha-esque reputation. As Goku's brother, Raditz actually has even more potential, as evident by his much higher Power Level at the start of Dragon Ball Z .
Unfortunately, Raditz never got to live up to Goku, Gohan, and Bardock's legacies, fading into the background as a minor villain. Even across the Dragon Ball multiverse, Raditz doesn't appear often, but when he does, he at least always leaves quite the impression. The strongest versions of Raditz in the Dragon Ball multiverse are warriors with the potential to rival Goku some day.
5 SD Raditz Proved He & Goku Could Be Friends
Dragon Ball SD is a parody manga that retells the original story with a greater emphasis on gags. Dragon Ball SD includes a mini-arc where Raditz and Vegeta go to Earth years before the Saiyan Saga and end up meeting Goku. In-between Fortune-teller Baba's Tournament and the Tien Shinhan Saga, Kid Goku actually befriends Kid Raditz and Kid Vegeta, showing that the trio could have co-existed.
Unfortunately, Raditz and Vegeta end up losing their memories shortly after they meet Goku, preserving the status quo needed for the Saiyan Saga to be able to happen. As a teenager, SD Raditz likely had a Power Level in the low 100s (if not lower). While this excursion is obviously non-canon to Toriyama's manga, Raditz's design in Dragon Ball SD is canon and consistent with his look in Dragon Ball Super: Broly .
4 Canon Raditz Died With a Power Level of 1,500
Although he was quickly outclassed by the end of the Saiyan Saga, Raditz was easily the strongest character Dragon Ball had ever seen when he was introduced in DBZ . Raditz had a Power Level of 1,500 when Goku and Piccolo were barely cracking 400. Raditz gave Goku his worst beat down in the series at the time, dancing around his brother while breaking him down with the weight of his blows. Raditz immediately put into perspective just how dangerous the Saiyans would be.
As strong as he was, Raditz's downfall was how much he believed in Power Levels. Although Goku and Piccolo were objectively weaker, they fought better and smarter, utilizing tag-team tactics and unique techniques to slowly wear Raditz down. Not only that, Raditz always fights at full power, whereas Goku and Piccolo suppress their Ki in order to adapt to the flow of battle.
3 Phantom Raditz's Strength is Based on Goku & Krillin's Memories
In the Dragon Ball Super anime, Goku and Krillin briefly train together for the Tournament of Power. In a back to basics mini-arc, Goku and Krillin hunt down the Paradise Herb, a quest which ends up forcing them to confront their former foes. The phantoms in this mini-arc are nothing but mere illusions, but as seen throughout Dragon Ball , even something like image training is capable of producing a powerful fighter (otherwise, how would Frieza grow stronger by image training in Hell?)
Phantom Raditz is one of the many villains who appear to terrorize Goku and Vegeta. Being Goku's brother, Phantom Raditz is obviously manifested from their battle in the Saiyan Saga, but Krillin also took a tail to the face from Raditz early on in Dragon Ball Z . Since Phantom Raditz is born out of Goku and Krillin's memories of him, his Power Level is an amalgamation of how they reflect on his strength at the time, rather than 1:1 with Canon Raditz's actual capabilities.
2 What If Raditz Could Have Been a Real Z-Fighter
Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 2 features a What If scenario called Fateful Brothers where Radtiz suffers a similar type of amnesia to Goku's head bump, briefly turning him into a hero. Raditz lives alongside Goku and Gohan for a while, but when his memory eventually returns, he finds himself at war with his Saiyan heritage. Unlike Canon Raditz, What If Raditz actually had a close relationship with Bardock .
When Raditz regains his memory and attacks the Z-Fighters, he ends up meeting his father in a dream, with Bardock talking him through his emotional crisis. Stronger than ever from having trained with Goku, and now with a newfound respect for his brother's power, Raditz leaves Earth and crashes his space pod into Nappa and Vegeta, killing both Saiyans and sparing the Earth from a needless battle.
1 Team 10 Raditz is One of the Strongest Evil Saiyans in the Multiverse
The Super Space-Time Tournament is a multi-team tournament from Super Dragon Ball Heroes that pits twelve teams of the most powerful fighters in the multiverse against one another. While this sounds just like the Tournament of Power, Super Dragon Ball Heroes ' multiverse is made up of much stronger universes, as well as crazier timelines . Team 10 ends up recruiting a version of Raditz who lost himself within the Cracks of Time.
Inside the Cracks of Time, Raditz traveled from timeline to timeline, gradually fighting stronger and stronger opponents until he unlocked Super Saiyan 3. Team 10 Raditz ends up fighting Turles during the Super Space-Time Tournament, who awakens to Super Saiyan 3's full power when coming into contact with Xeno's Evil Aura. Power-wise, Team 10 Raditz is about as strong as the weaker warriors in the Tournament of Power, which is pretty impressive for someone widely considered the weakest Saiyan.
